subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about paying per validated web sale rather than per click. Marking 14 years in Uganda, Jumia has pushed past Kampala through a network of more than 6,000 J-Force agents, so demand is spreading upcountry where every traced order counts more. Against that, 2026 ecommerce search CPAs average about $49.80 and display about $71.30, the spread where order-level validation and incrementality decide your real cost. We run on a holdout and credit only the sales you would not have closed organically. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: Jumia Uganda 14-year upcountry expansion via J-Force (sourced) + 2026 ecommerce CPA band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN ecommerce CPS Uganda: acknowledges second follow-up + references prior; fresh angle = timely sourced development (Jumia Uganda 14-year upcountry expansion, 6,000+ J-Force agents, softpower June 2026) + real ecommerce CPA band (search ~$49.80, display ~$71.30, amraandelma 2026); MobUpps holdout/incrementality reference carries no figure; exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; brand named only from candidates (Jumia); native English; no 'X, not Y'; market context sourced with URLs.
